description_en: Disassociates an additional certificate from an HTTPS listener
description_zh: 调用DissociateAdditionalCertificatesFromListener接口将扩展证书与HTTPS监听解绑
kebab_example: aliyun ga dissociate-additional-certificates-from-listener --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --listener-id lsr-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000 --domains example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: DissociateAdditionalCertificatesFromListener

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that it is unique among all requests. ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not set this parameter, ClientToken is set to the value of RequestId. The value of RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the GA instance
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name associated with the additional certificate.

You can specify up to 10 domain names in each request
parameters.name: domains
